purpose: Evidenced FX rates used by build_fact_ledger to convert non-USD SEC companyfacts values into the USD-millions interface the method compilers assume. A companyfacts fact whose unit key is not USD refuses to lock unless a usable row exists here.

DKK.source: ECB reference exchange rates 2025-12-31: 7.4689 DKK/EUR divided by 1.1750 USD/EUR (data-api.ecb.europa.eu EXR/D.DKK+USD.EUR.SP00.A); matches api.frankfurter.app/2025-12-31?from=USD&to=DKK
